summary: The attention refresher reads a prompt card's transcript on this node again only after the transcript changes, or once a minute, instead of in every fold, so a host with many prompt cards publishes attention as fast as one with few

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: Cards show the same calls. The transcript watcher that already wakes the refresher now also records which followed transcript changed. A transcript is read again after a change to it, after the watcher lost events or what it watches changed, when a card reads it again after a refresh in which none did, and at least once a minute in case an event was lost unreported, so a new prompt shows within a minute even then.

recovery.detail: An older build reads every card's transcript in every fold again.
